zh: 老板们，小企业用 AI，第一步到底该做什么？
en: Small business owners, what is the first step with AI?

zh: 最靠谱的第一步，是找一个每天你都不想再亲自做的重复动作。
en: Start with one repeated task you do not want to do by hand every day.

zh: 为什么？因为很多人现在用的 AI，还停留在 ChatGPT 聊天窗口里。
en: Why? Because many people still use AI only inside a ChatGPT chat window.

zh: 你让它写个文案、写个通知、解释一份表格，它确实挺行。
en: It can write copy, draft notices, and explain spreadsheets. It is useful.

zh: 但你关掉窗口以后，公司该怎么跑还是怎么跑。
en: But after you close the window, the business still runs the same way.

zh: 客户消息还是你盯，报价还是你追，发票还是你催，招聘还是你筛。
en: You still watch messages, chase quotes, push invoices, and screen hires.

zh: 这中间差得很远。过去的 AI 更像聊天机器人，你问它答一句。
en: That is a big gap. Old AI was more like a chatbot: you ask, it answers.

zh: 简单说，它不是只回答你，而是能替你完成一段工作。
en: Simply put, it should not only answer you. It should complete part of the work.

zh: 比如营销上，它可以根据你店里的真实信息，写本地广告。
en: For marketing, it can use your real store information to write local ads.

zh: 网站文案、短视频脚本、客户评论回复。
en: Website copy, short-video scripts, and replies to customer comments.

zh: 客服上，它可以帮你整理电话和收件箱，把客户分类，再提醒你跟进。
en: For service, it can organize calls and inboxes, classify customers, and remind follow-ups.

zh: 小企业用 AI，最重要的纪律是：AI 是做事。
en: The key discipline for small businesses is this: AI does the work.

zh: 人守规矩。凡是要发给客户的、要付款的，
en: People guard the rules. Anything sent to customers or involving payment,

zh: 要发布的、要提交的，都不能让 AI 直接放出去，必须有人确认。
en: anything published or submitted, cannot go out directly from AI. A person must confirm.

zh: 这不是保守，这是小企业最该有的安全边界。
en: This is not being conservative. This is the safety boundary a small business needs.

zh: 那具体怎么开始？我建议你每天做一件事。
en: So how do you start? I suggest doing one thing every day.

zh: 列一个反待办清单，不是写你今天要做什么。
en: Make an anti-to-do list. Do not write what you need to do today.

zh: 而是写哪些事，你以后再也不想亲手做。注意，只挑一个。
en: Write what you do not want to do by hand anymore. Pick only one.

zh: 然后把相关资料整理给 AI：产品介绍、报价规则、常见问题、客户聊天记录。
en: Then give AI the related materials: product info, pricing rules, FAQs, and chat records.

zh: 再加上历史文案，让它在内部帮你跑一周。
en: Add past copy, then let it run internally for one week.

zh: 这一周，你只看三个指标。第一，它有没有真的省时间。
en: For that week, watch only three metrics. First, did it really save time?

zh: 第二，它有没有减少漏跟进。第三，它输出的东西，
en: Second, did it reduce missed follow-ups? Third, the things it outputs,

zh: 你改一改是不是就能用。
en: can you use them after small edits?

zh: 如果可以，就继续优化这个场景；如果不行，先别骂 AI。
en: If yes, keep improving this scene. If not, do not blame AI first.

zh: 也别着急换工具。你先看，是不是你给它的资料太少、太旧、太乱？
en: Do not rush to change tools. First check if your material is too little, old, or messy.

zh: AI 做不好，很多时候不是模型的问题，是公司自己的信息没准备好。
en: When AI performs badly, often the model is not the problem. The company information is not ready.

zh: 所以小企业用 AI，真正的起点不是工具，而是业务动作。
en: So the real starting point is not the tool. It is the business action.

zh: 先找一个重复、高频、低风险、能检查的任务，让 AI 做，人来把关。
en: Find one repeated, frequent, low-risk, checkable task. Let AI do it, and people guard it.

zh: 所以今天这条你只记住一句话：小企业用 AI，不要先追风口。
en: So remember one sentence today: small businesses should not chase hype first.

zh: 先省下一个人的半小时。半小时省下来，业务跑顺了，
en: Save one person half an hour first. Once the business runs smoother,

zh: 我们再谈系统化、自动化、智能化，这才是能落地的 AI 第一步。
en: then talk about systems, automation, and intelligence. That is the first step that lands.
